# Prowl Infra Hub
> A curated registry of validated infrastructure automation templates.

## API
- GET /api/playbooks — Full catalog (JSON)
- GET /api/playbooks/search?q=&category=&tags=&tool=&cloud_provider=&risk_level= — Search
- GET /api/playbooks/{id} — Single playbook with content
- GET /api/playbooks/file?path= — Download raw YAML
- GET /api/openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.0 specification

## Categories
patching, provisioning, security, monitoring, containers, networking, backup, configuration, ci-cd

## Supported Tools
ansible (more coming soon: terraform, docker-compose, k8s)

## Schema
Each playbook template includes: name, description, tags, tool, cloud_provider, os_family, risk_level, compliance_tags, vars, and playbook content.

## Usage
1. Search for playbooks matching your infrastructure need
2. Download the YAML template
3. Customize variables for your environment
4. Run with your existing automation tools (e.g. ansible-playbook)
